{{disambig}}
[[File:dino_preview.png|right]][[Dinosaur|Dinosaurs]] are reptillian creatures with warm blood and hollow bones, introduced in the [[Dino Update]] alongside other real-world [[Extinction|extinct]] creatures. This is a list of all dinosaurs in ''Dwarf Fortress''.

==Trivia==
*Before the release of the Dino Update, some [[megabeast|procedurally-generated creatures]] took the forms of extinct creatures before they were officially added to the game, which could be seen through their descriptions. In graphics mode, their appearance will be limited to the sprites dedicated to generated creatures. One example can be seen in [[Media:df_predino_example.png|this screenshot]].
